relations: The upper-left magenta burst blooms and overlaps the gold burst, its streaks dimming into glowing dots.
A new white-gold starburst erupts at the left-center, expanding with white clusters spreading right and downward.
The glittering field shifts from gold and white to green, with a red dot persisting on the right.
A smoke plume lingers at the lower-left, tinted pink then green, as a bright white dot drifts downward.
caption: The video captures a night-sky fireworks display against a black background, where a small white-gold starburst is already partly expanded near the bottom-center, faint sparks scattered above. A magenta burst blooms at the upper-left, growing into a shell of pink streaks whose tips become glowing dots, overlapping the gold burst below. The pink shell's streaks dim into discrete dots as it fades, leaving the gold burst brighter before it dims. A new white-gold burst erupts at the left-center, expanding into a glittering starburst with small white clusters spreading right and downward. The glittering field shifts from gold and white to green, sparkling dots dominating the left and center while a red dot persists on the right. The green dots thin out as the scene darkens, a bright white dot drifting downward while a smoke plume lingers at the lower-left, tinted pink then green.
